hooks.name: Warn on Empty Content Article
hooks.description: Checks if a saved content/*.md file is empty and warns immediately so the article isn't silently skipped by Pelican

action.command: FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -s "$FILE" ]; then echo "⚠️  WARNING: '$FILE' is empty. Pelican will skip this article — it won't appear in devserver or after publish." >&2; exit 1; fi
